title: Infographic Workflow for Creating a Causal Loop Diagram
description: An interactive infographic-style workflow for the 12 steps in creating a causal loop diagram
subject: Mathematics
topic: Infographic Workflow for Creating a Causal Loop Diagram
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Sequence the 12 steps of building a causal loop diagram from problem definition through intervention design
Explain why the boundary set in Step 1 determines which variables belong inside the system under study
Distinguish the foundation, system mapping, and validation-and-leverage phases of the workflow
Apply the workflow to map a recurring organizational problem into variables and causal links
Identify leverage points as an output of the validation stage rather than of the initial mapping stage
